title: Earth vs the Flying Saucers
description: Sci-fi thriller. Hugh Marlowe stars as a scientist who discovers Earth is threatened by a fleet of flying saucers bent on global conquest. With special effects by Ray Harryhausen.

title: A Christmas Carol
description: George C Scott stars in Clive Donner's adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic festive fantasy. The miserly curmudgeon Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by three ghosts of Christmas.

title: Miracle on 34th Street
description: Festive family drama. Richard Attenborough stars as a department store Santa who insists he's the real Santa Claus. But can he prove it in court.

title: 10 Things I Hate About You
description: Teen comedy with Julia Stiles and Heath Ledger. A student is furious to discover that her sister bribed her prom date to invite her. But then he falls for her..

title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
description: Sci-fi action reboot starring James Franco and Andy Serkis. A scientist seeking a cure for Alzheimer's bestows super-intelligence on a chimpanzee and endangers all mankind. Violence.

title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
description: Tom Hardy returns as Marvel's gnarly antihero, to face a symbiote spawned from Venom's own blood living inside a serial killer who looks just like Woody Harrelson. Yikes.

title: The Creator
description: Sci-fi extravaganza starring John David Washington. An undercover operative must destroy a superweapon in a war against AI. But the superweapon looks like a little girl.

title: The Artifice Girl
description: Franklin Ritch's strikingly claustrophobic AI thriller. A man creates a virtual nine-year-old to lure online predators from the shadows. But as she learns, she becomes more real..

title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
description: WWII spy adventure starring Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce. Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson attempt to prevent the Nazis from acquiring a revolutionary invention.

title: Arthur Christmas
description: Aardman CGI animated comedy. When a little girl's Christmas present is forgotten, Santa's son Arthur (voiced by James McAvoy) sets out to deliver it - causing mayhem along the way.

title: Tooth Fairy
description: Family fantasy comedy. Dwayne Johnson stars as a tough ice hockey player who is transformed into a real-life fairy as punishment for telling a child that tooth fairies don't exist.

title: The Kid Who Would Be King
description: Fantasy adventure. A 12-year-old from modern-day suburbia finds King Arthur's sword Excalibur and must save the country from a sinister sorceress. With Patrick Stewart.

title: The Adjustment Bureau
description: Romance meets sci-fi thriller. Matt Damon and Emily Blunt star as a politician and a dancer who begin to suspect that a shadowy group of men are interfering with their lives.

title: Wild Horse Nine Interview Special
description: Writer/director Martin McDonagh and cast discuss the Film4-produced political comedy thriller Wild Horse Nine.

title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
description: Sci-fi action-adventure sequel with Gary Oldman, Toby Kebbell and Andy Serkis. Human survivors of a deadly simian flu clash with a mighty civilisation of intelligent apes.
